subject: Renewal kickoff: capacity runway inspection + upgrade handshake
body:
From: Alex Rivera <alex@orbitai.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment

Hi Grace —

We’re starting to align internally for OrbitAI’s June renewal and want to kick off a short renewal/upgrade conversation. Our usage has grown ~2.8x across Q1–Q2 (mostly embeddings + chat inference) and we’re evaluating (a) a term extension with an uplifted committed throughput and (b) a shorter path to burst capacity during peak jobs.

Primary ask: can Redwood help map an operational runway and surface recommended term/commit increments so we can budget and coordinate procurement?

I’ll loop in Sofia (I’ll be sending the procurement contact later) — ideally we’d pick a QBR + technical run-through this month.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Director of Infrastructure, OrbitAI
---

On Tue, 1 Jun 2027 at 10:03 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
> To: Alex Rivera <alex@orbitai.com>
> Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment
>
> Hi Alex — great to hear from you and congrats on the growth. I can own the orchestration.
>
> Quick proposal to structure the kickoff:
> 1) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft with milestones: pricing, procurement paperwork, technical QBR, and final signature. I'll attach a starting MAP and capacity worksheet.
> 2) Two QBR slots: week of Jun 14 (AM) and week of Jun 21 (PM) — please flag preferred times.
> 3) Stakeholder map: we'll need Procurement, Platform Eng (for burst test), and your Data Privacy lead if there are governance asks.
>
> Action items for this thread:
> - Alex: confirm stakeholders (procurement contact + who owns burst tests)
> - I'll pull pricing options and loop in Ben (pricing/discount owner) and Monica (CSM for onboarding cadence)
>
> Attaching: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (term/commit options), capacity_runway_v2.xlsx (workload profile template)
>
> Best,
> Grace O'Connor
> Account Executive, Redwood Inference
> T: (415) 555-0198

---

On Wed, 2 Jun 2027 at 08:21 AM Alex Rivera <alex@orbitai.com> wrote:
> Grace — thanks for the quick plan. Looping Sofia and procurement:
>
> From: Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@orbitai.com>
> To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai; alex@orbitai.com
> Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:20:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment
>
> Hi Grace — I own procurement. Procurement contact: procurement@orbitai.com.
>
> Quick context: legal will want a 12–24 month term option and we prefer simple amendments to limit procurement cycles. We also want explicit SLA/latency targets for peak burst windows.
>
> For scheduling, Jun 15 (10:00–11:00 PT) works best for our exec/ops mix.
>
> Cheers,
> Sofia Turner
> Head of Business Ops, OrbitAI

---

On Wed, 2 Jun 2027 at 11:07 AM Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
> To: Alex Rivera <alex@orbitai.com>, Sofia Turner <sofia.turner@orbitai.com>
> Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
> Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment
>
> Thanks, Sofia — Jun 15 10:00 PT is on my calendar. I've copied Ben and Monica to accelerate pricing and the onboarding cadence.
>
> Ben: I recommend we prepare two commercial tracks:
> - Track A: 12-month term, 2.5x committed throughput, modest uplift on per-token price, burst pool add-on (90% available, usage-based overage cap)
> - Track B: 24-month term, 2x committed throughput, steeper term discount + reserved burst credits included
>
> Monica: can you outline a 90-day onboarding + burst validation plan for the QBR? If we include a short pilot for the burst workflow, we can reduce Prod cutover risk.
>
> I'll also attach the draft QBR deck and the amendment stub for redlines.
>
> Best,
> Grace
>
---

On Thu, 3 Jun 2027 at 15:48:00 -0700 Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
> To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
> Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, alex@orbitai.com, sofia.turner@orbitai.com, procurement@orbitai.com
> Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 15:48:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment
>
> Team — thanks for the context. I ran initial math and attached a clean commercial summary (proposed_amendment_v1.pdf) and the capacity workbook. Key notes:
>
> - We can offer Track B (24mo) at a 16% blended discount vs current list if OrbitAI commits to 2x throughput and adds the reserved burst credits.
> - If OrbitAI prefers the 12mo runway (Track A) I can approve a 9% blended discount with a capped overage rate for burst usage.
> - I am comfortable with a one-time onboarding credit to offset the pilot cost (we captured this in the commercial summary).
>
> Marissa — do we want to approve the one-time onboarding credit at $12k? This helps close the pilot decision quickly.
>
> Alex/Sofia — I put a tentative DocuSign template in our related links; once you’re happy with the amendment I’ll hand off to contracts.
>
> Cheers,
> Ben Carter
> Sales Director, Redwood Inference
>
> Attachments: proposed_amendment_v1.pdf, capacity_runway_v2.xlsx, qbr-deck-draft.pptx

---

On Thu, 3 Jun 2027 at 16:10:00 -0700 Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
> To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
> Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, alex@orbitai.com
> Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: Renewal kickoff & capacity runway assessment
>
> Ben — approved. One-time onboarding credit of $12,000 is OK. Move forward with Track B pricing as primary and present Track A as fallback.
>
> Grace — please confirm QBR invite and include the onboarding pilot success criteria in the QBR deck.
>
> Marissa Cole
> VP, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
>
---

On Thu, 3 Jun 2027 at 16:22:00 -0700 Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex/Sofia/Procurement — thanks. I'll send a calendar invite for Jun 15 10:00 PT with the QBR deck and the MAP attached.
>
> Next steps (short):
> - I: send QBR invite + MAP + amended amendment stub (today EOD)
> - Alex/Sofia: confirm any additional legal SLAs to include as explicit commitments in the amendment (latency windows for burst)
> - Monica: prepare 90-day pilot plan and success criteria (deliverable at QBR)
> - Ben: finalize commercial summary and upload DocuSign ready file after Alex gives redline confirmation
>
> Thanks all — looking forward to the run-through.
>
> Grace
> Account Executive, Redwood Inference
>
